changes: CPP-MOD-005 inspects written Auto type through pointer/reference wrappers; already-auto, const auto, decltype(auto), macro and nested initializer cases remain correctly distinguished.
CPP-CX-001 counts semantic logical AST nodes once, including alternative tokens and macro expansions, with nested callable/default-argument scope separation.
Uninstantiated function/member templates are handled by complexity, source-length and declared-parameter checks.

Lambda capture initializers omitted by libclang visitation are recovered through actual token annotations and maximal expression-root traversal; nested lambda bodies and overloaded operators stay excluded.

checks.result: 7/7 regression cases failed before production edits

test_authoring_note: Initial fixture test compile used two incorrect setter names; corrected before the retained product red run. This was not counted as a product defect or passing verification.
limits: Named libclang header/runtime qualified here:19.1.7 only. Semantic binary-opcode API availability on other target pairs requires qualification.
This corrects existing threshold-rule behavior; it does not implement the complete measured metrics pipeline or emit independent lambda-body metrics.
Focused tests are not full native/Python/integration or performance qualification; root is coordinating final full native gate.
